scope: Head-only Blender refinement, head-only MetaHuman Conform, native parametric body; controlled staging candidate, not production replacement.
head_visual_review: Jaw/chin transitions less square; bridge and lobule rounder; mouth volume softer; mature orbital aperture retained. Front, side and both three-quarter views reviewed against supplied concept.
conform_review: Native neck adaptation and native HeadScale compensation retain facial form. Face-region rigid-only error below 0.758 mm. Neck interface deliberately adapts to native body.
facial_review: 19 actual RigLogic states, two views each. Blink closes and left/right blink isolates; gaze, brows, smile, jaw and lips move. Full funnel shows tight corner/perioral folding; lip-contact quality across blends and lower LODs not certified. Remains PARTIAL.
body_review: Native back coherent; waist less pinched, ribcage/chest integrated, arms and lower legs more active in silhouette. Reference is not a scan and chest support is not copied.
body_pose_review: 12 named cases plus eight locomotion phase samples, 44 actual Unreal captures. Native post process and Face Copy Pose active; matching head bones. No major new tearing or disconnected neck in inspected poses. This is not gameplay/retarget/foot-contact certification.
remaining_risks: Extreme funnel/purse corner softness and blended speech lip contact require a dedicated facial polish/validation pass.
LOD0 only; lower LOD facial/body quality not certified.
No final skin/groom/clothing or live gameplay integration tested.
Concept likeness is an artistic approximation, not a calibrated reconstruction.
